exportSummaries.PARAMETRIC_KINDS: Kinds that get purpose-built multi-mesh geometry (parametric path).
exportSummaries.PATIENT_CHAIR_SEAT_HEIGHT_METERS: Seat height of the procedural patient chair (meters above floor).
exportSummaries.RoomPropClass: #223 — roomProp vocabulary: physical furniture vs pedagogical cue/overlay.
exportSummaries.STRETCHER_DECK_TOP_METERS: Top of the mattress deck (meters above floor) — seat surface height when flat.
exportSummaries.STRETCHER_LENGTH_METERS: Overall mattress length (long horizontal axis, meters).
exportSummaries.anchorFixtureNearFaceToPlane: #342c — slide a fixture along its wall's NORMAL so its nearest face sits `insetMeters` from the wall's inner plane.
exportSummaries.applyStationInteriorLighting: Apply one named interior lighting variant on the product scene.
exportSummaries.buildDeclaredEquipmentGeometry: Build multi-mesh geometry for a non-GLB equipment id.
exportSummaries.buildDoorLeafFixture: Solid door leaf at the open front of the shell (learner entry).
exportSummaries.buildGenericClinicalEquipmentFallback: Generic multi-mesh clinical cart fallback (beats a single scaled cube).
exportSummaries.buildGltfEquipmentPlaceholderSlot: Placeholder slot mesh used under a GLB load (hidden when GLB attaches).
exportSummaries.buildPatientChair: Build a simple chair: legs + seat + back.
exportSummaries.buildPatientStretcher: Build a stretcher: base frame + articulating mattress (seat + back) + rails + pillow.
exportSummaries.buildRoomPropGroup: Build a room-prop root, or null when XOR suppresses (already equipment-mounted).
exportSummaries.buildRoomPropMaterialColours: Build material colours for a list of room props.
exportSummaries.buildStationEnvironment: Build a three.js Group for the encounter-side station shell (floor + walls + ceiling + fixtures).
exportSummaries.buildWallBoardFixture: Wall-mounted clinical board (not a 1×1×1 prop cube).
exportSummaries.classifyInitialVitalsRaw: Classify a raw shipped string (for inspect / migration).
exportSummaries.collectDeclaredEquipmentEvidenceFromScen: Re-scan scene roots tagged with openClinXrEquipmentId (after GLB attach).
exportSummaries.countEquipmentGeometry: Real equipment GLBs — catalog lives in station-equipment-catalog.js.
exportSummaries.enableCaptureRendererShadowMap: Enable shadow mapping on the capture renderer.
exportSummaries.findProceduralStretcher: Find the procedural stretcher under a scene/root (userData kind or name).
exportSummaries.findProceduralStretcherInSceneOf: Walk to scene root from any node, then find the procedural stretcher (#171 plant seam).
exportSummaries.inspectStationFixtureVocabulary: Optional equipment id list per environment (caller may supply from manifests).
exportSummaries.isCaptureShadowPath: True when the running page is a capture (URL carries capture/openclinxrCaptureMode).
exportSummaries.listDeclaredEquipmentBuilderArms: Sorted dedicated builder arm ids (discoverable; do not hardcode in evidence).
exportSummaries.markActorCastShadow: Capture path only: every mesh of a loaded humanoid casts a contact shadow.
exportSummaries.markFloorReceiveShadow: Capture path only: the floor receives contact shadows (floor top is y = 0).
exportSummaries.measureParametricComposite: Build the parametric composite for `equipmentId` exactly as the runtime mounts it (buildDeclaredEquipmentGeometry) and measure its local AABB: total bounds, per-mesh bounds (after updateMatrixWorld, so builder-applied transforms count), and triangle counts.
exportSummaries.normalizeGltfEquipmentMount: #258 — normalize a freshly loaded equipment GLB to the placement descriptor's convention.
exportSummaries.parametricEquipmentKindCount: Count of parametric equipment builders — counterweight for real-GLB assembly work (#168).
exportSummaries.parametricWallInnerPlane: #342c — world coordinate of a named parametric wall's INNER face.
exportSummaries.planStationEquipmentMounts: Build the ordered list of equipment the station should mount.
exportSummaries.readStretcherBackSectionWorldDeg: Live world-space angle of the back section top from horizontal (degrees).
exportSummaries.readStretcherInclineDegrees: Read the incline SSOT from stretcher userData (deck leads).
exportSummaries.readStretcherPillowWorld: Live world position of the procedural pillow mesh (rides the HOB back section).
exportSummaries.resolveChartFieldsForScenario: Resolve honest chart rows for a station.
exportSummaries.resolveInitialVitalsForScenario: Resolve honest vitals for a station.
exportSummaries.resolveRoomPropBuilderEquipmentId: #185 — resolve a roomProp propId to a parametric builder arm, or null.
exportSummaries.resolveStationEnvironment: Prefer a compiled room GLB from encounter materialization when a URL + compile node id are present.
exportSummaries.resolveStationInteriorLightingVariantId: Resolve URL/query id; unknown or absent → control (do not invent a shipped pick).
exportSummaries.roomPropColourNumbers: Body/accent numbers for createDetailedEdRoomProps / roomProp meshes.
exportSummaries.roomPropSuppressedByFixtureOwnership: True when a roomProp body mesh must not render (metadata-only or fixture-owned).
exportSummaries.stampRoomPropAliasesOnEquipmentRoot: Stamp reverse roomProp aliases onto an equipment root (no extra geometry).
exportSummaries.stampSuppressedDeclaredEquipmentOntoFixt: #209 — collect declared equipment + non-cue roomProp ids, stamp any that were not mounted by the plan onto fulfilling fixtures.
